product_updates.title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
product_updates.content: Blue Cross Blue Shield says hospital use of AI tools led to an additional $942M in healthcare spending over a two-year period.

product_updates.title: I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
product_updates.content: After obtaining an interactive avatar and training it to discuss venture fraud, I have mixed feelings about making AI clones of ourselves.

product_updates.title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
product_updates.content: The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses.
